faq.q: Who owns the music I generate?
faq.a: If you have an active membership, you own 100% of the rights (Royalty Free). Free plan users retain 40%, while DGB Studio/ODGMUSIC retains 60%.
Yes. Your Vocal DNA is processed with encryption and is strictly private. It is never shared without your express consent.

faq.q: How does distribution with ODGMUSIC work?
faq.a: When you choose to distribute with us, a 50/50 split on net revenue applies. ODGMUSIC (ASCAP-affiliated) administers your publishing rights worldwide.

faq.q: Can I register my songs with a PRO?
faq.a: Yes. From the Copyright Hub you can prepare and export your registrations for ASCAP, BMI, SESAC or other rights organizations.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: Music generated during your active membership keeps its Royalty Free rights. New creations after canceling are governed by the 60/40 rule.

terms.mainTitle: TERMS OF SERVICE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT FOR DGB STUDIO CLOUD ENGINE
terms.operatedBy: Operated by: DGB STUDIO & ODGMUSIC LATIN WORLDWIDE PUBLISHING
terms.intro: By accessing or using the DGB STUDIO Cloud Engine service, you (the "User") agree to be legally bound by the following terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

section1.title: 1. OWNERSHIP AND MEMBERSHIP MODEL (60/40 RULE)
section1.activeMembershipDesc: Users who maintain a paid subscription have full commercial rights over generated content. Music is "Royalty Free" for the user under this plan.
section1.freePlanDesc: To offset the use of our infrastructure and exclusive instrument libraries, the User agrees that DGB STUDIO / ODGMUSIC will automatically retain 60% of the copyright and related rights over each generated work.

section2.title: 2. VOCAL DNA AND RVC MODEL PRIVACY
section2.privateUseDesc: Audio files uploaded for voice training are processed in encrypted form. The resulting voice model belongs to the User and is strictly private.
section2.thirdPartyDesc: DGB STUDIO will not share, give away, or use your vocal DNA for other users without your express consent through the "Discover" section.

section3.title: 3. INSTRUMENTATION AND PERFORMANCE DNA (LIMITATION OF LIABILITY)
section3.originalInstrumentsDesc: The system uses models trained with real instruments recorded by Danny Garcia and Dominican masters.
section3.thirdPartyInstrumentsDesc: DGB STUDIO allows the integration of external models. However, the system is not responsible if the generated audio infringes on the "performance DNA" of a real musician.
section3.creatorResponsibilityDesc: If an artist publishes or distributes a song that generates intellectual property claims due to its performance style, full legal responsibility falls on the Artist/User, exempting DGB STUDIO from any litigation.

section4.title: 4. PUBLISHING AND DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (ODGMUSIC)
section4.designationDesc: By selecting the "Distribute with us" option, the User designates ODGMUSIC LATIN WORLDWIDE PUBLISHING (affiliated with ASCAP) as their exclusive worldwide publishing administrator.
section4.royaltySplitsDesc: An administration contract will apply with a 50% split for the Artist and 50% for the Publisher on net revenues collected from mechanical exploitation, synchronization, and digital sales.

section5.title: 5. PROHIBITED USES
section5.p1: The use of automated systems (bots) to massively generate content that saturates the Cloud Engine infrastructure is prohibited.
section5.p2: The creation of defamatory, illegal content or content that infringes third-party rights using synthetic voices of public figures without authorization is not permitted.

section1.title: 1.1. Information We Collect
section1.accountDataDesc: Email, artist name, and login data (Google, Discord, etc.).
section1.vocalDnaDesc: .wav or .mp3 files you upload to train RVC models.
section1.usageDataDesc: Text prompts, generation logs, and created audio files.

section2.title: 1.2. Data Usage and "Vocal DNA"
section2.privacyByDesignDesc: Your training audio files are used exclusively to process your personal model. DGB STUDIO does not sell, give away, or use your voices to train public models without your express permission.
section2.securityDesc: We use high-level encryption to ensure your voice model is only accessible from your account.
section2.serviceImprovementDesc: Usage data (not voices) is analyzed anonymously to optimize our servers and bachata and bolero algorithms.

section3.title: 1.3. Data Sharing
section3.intro: We do not share your data with third parties, except:
section3.item2: For official Copyright and Publishing registrations with ODGMUSIC / ASCAP (only if you choose to distribute with us).
section3.item3: As required by competent legal authorities.

section4.title: 1.4. Your Rights
section4.intro: As an artist, you have the right to:
section4.deleteDataDesc: You can delete your voice models and files at any time.
section4.portabilityDesc: Request a copy of your creations.
section4.accessDesc: Know exactly what information we have stored.

section1.title: 2.1. What Are Cookies?
section1.description: Cookies are small text files that help us make your experience on the DGB STUDIO Cloud Engine smooth and professional.

section2.title: 2.2. Types of Cookies We Use
section2.essentialDesc: Required to keep your session active while training your models or generating music. Without these, the system would not function.
section2.performanceDesc: Help us know if the server is slow or if there are errors in the "Process Data" or "Train" process.
section2.functionalDesc: Remember your preferences, such as language or the configuration of your favorite AI models.
section2.analyticsDesc: Allow us to understand which features are most used by musicians to continue improving the system.

section3.title: 2.3. Cookie Control
section3.description: You can disable cookies from your browser settings. However, please note that critical features such as voice training and access to your ODGMUSIC dashboard may be affected.
